summary: Smoke test of Customer CRUD + Chilean RUT validation + store filters. Backend endpoints (GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/customers) and full frontend E2E flow verified. All primary user journeys work end-to-end.
passed: Backend POST /api/customers rejects invalid RUT (12.345.678-9) with 400 and expected error message
Backend POST /api/customers accepts valid RUT (12.345.678-5) and returns 200 with all new fields (customer_type, rut, sin_rut, nombre_fantasia, giro, direccion, ciudad, email)
Backend PUT /api/customers/{id} updates fields successfully (verified with phone update)
Backend GET /api/customers returns 200 with tenant-filtered data
Frontend login (hola@tricomar.cl) succeeds and navigates to /dashboard
Customers page loads at /customers via Clientes nav button; store filter buttons render (Todas, PetShop, GrowShop)
CustomerForm modal opens: fields NOMBRE DE FANTASÍA and GIRO are hidden for tipo=Persona and appear when tipo=Empresa (conditional rendering works)
Real-time RUT validation: 'RUT inválido' error shown for 12.345.678-9, cleared for 12.345.678-5
E2E create Persona customer with valid RUT + store selection succeeds; new row appears in the table
E2E edit customer via pencil icon: name update persists and new name visible in table
E2E delete customer via trash icon + confirm dialog: row removed and 'Cliente eliminado' toast confirmed
Store filter buttons work without page errors
action_items: Non-blocking: Dashboard shows 404 errors for some data-fetch endpoints in console (unrelated to Customers scope). Consider investigating in a later iteration.
